title: Massachusetts interchangeable-drug dispensing
rule_summary: A pharmacist dispenses a less expensive reasonably available interchangeable product listed under Massachusetts standards unless the prescriber validly indicates no substitution or another exception applies.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply generic interchange requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing generic interchange with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
